what: The direct-ABILITY grant edge: an ARG alternate that names its replacement row with ABILITY:<Race> Racial Trait|AUTOMATIC|<key> on its own row. Two rows affected — Scion of Humanity ~ Languages (Aasimar) and Feral ~ Languages (Orc). Neither ingest_race_traits_arg.rs nor race_resolver::classify reads that token, so both classify Unclassified and never apply; a player taking either alternate loses the race's standard Languages row with no replacement text.
